goal: Compare incremental procedural support and executable coordination against the existing activated project setup.
controls: Same frozen task and source evidence per case across conditions.
Same available model and tool permissions; no explicit model overrides.
Fresh subagent using fork_turns none for each trial.
Candidates receive neutral working directory and condition labels, not evaluator oracle or aggregate results.
Common repository instructions already activate pstack, so baseline is not a no-pstack control.

recording.rawFinal: Preserve each final response without editing.
recording.toolActions: Audit candidate workspace read/write commands from available transcripts or explicit call records; do not rely exclusively on candidate self-report.
recording.latency: Record observed timestamps only; no performance superiority claim.
recording.sourceIntegrity: SHA256 of fixture extracts, exact working-tree paths and revision metadata.

evaluation.structural: Schema validity, resolving source references and required output fields.
evaluation.semantic: Source-grounded independent review; structured assertions and keyword checks cannot prove meaning.
evaluation.enforcement: Actual subprocess assertions for prerequisites, stale source hashes, duplicate action IDs, restart, transition ordering and evidence presence.
evaluation.promotion: No production adoption based solely on these small hand-selected cases.

constraints: No production file edits, gate weakening, deployments, merges or external messages.
Prototype persistence and evaluation artifacts only.
A retry does not erase failed attempts.
No native-hook guarantee inferred from documentation or configuration existence.
